title: Computer Networks Security
objectives:
Computer networks security is a course designed to teach students about the fundamental concepts
and techniques used in securing computer networks. With the increasing reliance on computer
networks in modern society, network security has become a crucial aspect of information
technology. This course provides an overview of the principles, practices, and technologies used
in computer networks security. The course covers a variety of topics, including cryptography,
authentication, access control, firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention, virtual private
networks (VPNs), and secure network design. Students will learn about the types of vulnerabilities
and attacks that can affect computer networks and the ways to prevent and respond to such attacks.
The goals of this course are:
1. Learning the fundamentals of cryptography
2. Learning the security protocols used in computer networks
3. Learning how security protocols are broken and hacked
Upon successful completion of the course, students will be able to
1. Do basic encryption/decryptions
2. Design secure protocols
3. Analyze the security of protocols
4. Use existing standards to secure the computer networks
syllabus:
1- Fundamentals of Cryptography
2- Fundamentals of Computer Networks
3- Key Management
4- Authentication
5- Internet Security
- Web
- Firewall
- Email
- IDS
- VPN / IPSec
- DNS Security
6- Wireless Security
7- Access Control
8- Malware and Attacks
